newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Imsa started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Imsa started as buy.

text.p: ING Barings said in a statement on Monday it had begun covergae of Mexican steelmaker Grupo IMSA with a buy recommendation on the basis of potential price appreciation.
-- Analyst Daniel Goldstein estimated a target price of $25-1/2 per ADS for the end of 1997, and $32 by the close of 1998, the statement said.
-- "IMSA's steel sales are expected to increase by 19 percent in 1997 and 10 percent in 1998, due to volume sale increases since prices should remain stable," the statement added.
